text: {"lessons":["My account has declined from 104,474 to 91,915, a meaningful loss worth reviewing, but it does not predict what prices will do next.","Because losses weigh heavily on me, I should avoid fear-driven selling and base any trade on a clear reason rather than recent performance.","I have rarely traded and have seen no evidence that reacting to these random fluctuations would help; I will review my holdings periodically and trade deliberately."]}
